newsitem.title: FRANCE: PRESS DIGEST - LE MONDE - FEB 26.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - LE MONDE - FEB 26.

text.p: These are leading stories in afternoon daily Le Monde.
-- Interior Minister Jean-Louis Debre says his bill tightening controls on immigration is designed to help fight unemployment.
-- Carrefour Supermarche SA retail group to continue investing abroad.
-- Banking-sector unions seek to reshuffle working hours' organisation set by a 1937 decree preventing branch offices to open more than five days a week, or more than eight hours a day.
-- Auto parts maker Valeo seeks to do half of its sales outside of Europe within five years, sets a target of 40 billion francs of sales by the year 2000.
-- Elf Aquitaine chairman Philippe Jaffre seeks to steer oil group back to growth, wants to strengthen activity outside of Europe.
